video_title: Giannis says he's scared of change after trade to Miami & is open to return to Milwaukee

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis reflects on his legacy and impact in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: Hopefully when people see me and think about me, they think about the things that I've done
quotes.quote: Hopefully when people see me and think about me, they think about the things that I've done for the team and things that I've done for the city and how I carried myself and how I grew in this city and hopefully they remember those moments then what other people say I want.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis admits fear of change and leaving Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: I'm scared of change. I'm scared that the grass is not always greener.
quotes.quote: I'm scared. I'm scared of change. I'm scared that the grass is not always greener. I have things, people love me here, people respect me here, people allow me to be myself here in the city and I'm scared that I might never find that ever again. But there's something that I wake up every single day and I think I'm like, maybe I've waited too long.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis discusses the possibility of returning to Milwaukee

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Paschke
text_blocks.text: I would say that you could always come home.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: That would be awesome. You've earned that. You'll always be welcomed here. That would be awesome. That would be awesome if I can go and play and maybe come back. Kevin Garnett did the same thing. I saw this clip of him walking into the arena and they gave him a standing ovation and people to this day love him.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis explains his motivation for potential team changes
quotes.excerpt: It's different when you change your life for a better future for your family.
quotes.quote: Change is scary, Mr. Jim. Change is scary, it's not easy. It's different when you change your life for a better future for your family. I wasn't scared then. My brothers will have a better education, my mom and my dad will have a better life because they deserve it, they worked hard, they sacrificed for us. I was like, I'm going to do this.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis on his connection to the city of Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: The city of Milwaukee is a blue-collar city.
quotes.quote: If the city of Milwaukee and the state of Wisconsin, I want them to remember this from me. Don't worry about the basket, don't worry about the championship, don't worry about the winnings, don't worry about the losses. I try to be like them. I believe the city of Milwaukee is a blue-collar city. It's people that work extremely hard every single day, nine to five, and pay $10, $5, $15 to come watch the Milwaukee Bucks and the Brewers and other organizations play. They give all their hard-earned money to the Bucks to come and feel something, to come to be a part of us. I hope that I was able to represent them in the best that I could.
